prior_context.knowledge_summary: Before the interface scene, the protagonist is a young adult in South Korea who has spent years farming a family vineyard after unemployment. Falling crop prices and the approaching harvest constrain his income and free time. He has purchased a premium release in a stealth-action game series and has read its packaging: the prequel concerns a sixteenth-century Roanoke colony whose historical attempt failed. He expects an ordinary game and hopes the expensive purchase will be enjoyable. The interface and its options do not appear until the target begins.

direct_observations: The prior context contains present-day farming and income pressure, a purchased game, and the game-series premise and packaging information about Roanoke.

Within the target, an interface appears and offers an unfamiliar choice; after seeing it, the protagonist has a brief concern about an unreal event, dismisses it, and chooses to proceed. The interface implies his choice is already accepted; the computer powers off and will not restart.
